name: @ia2-dev/rdf-policy-reviewer
description: A live SHACL policy report and semantic-diff web component for HTML/RDF documents.
author: Yurii Rashkovskii

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --entry-names=rdf-policy-reviewer --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --minify --sourcemap=external && esbuild src/validation.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --packages=external --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/validation.js --minify --sourcemap=external && esbuild src/diff.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --packages=external --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/diff.js --minify --sourcemap=external
